title: Public API work order list filters by Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps: 1. Send GET for the work order list through the Public API with the Bill To filter set to customer B's id.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The response is 200.
  • Work order 1 is in the list.
  • Work order 2 is not in the list, although its customer is also customer A.
